instruction:
Use the ANSYS Workbench GUI to complete the following analysis:

Physical problem: fully constrained bar with uniform temperature rise generating thermal stress.

Model parameters:
- Block 100 mm x 10 mm x 10 mm
- Material: Structural Steel (confirm thermal expansion coefficient)

Boundary conditions and load:
- Both end faces: fully fixed
- Temperature field: uniform temperature rise of 80 K (from 20 degC to 100 degC)

Analysis type: coupled steady-state thermal + static structural analysis

Save requirements:
- Workbench project file: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\wb_thermal_stress.wbpj
- The project directory must include static structural results
